lines.t: (Verse 1)
Glory more than anything,
Wonderfulness no man can bring.
Truth that always stays the same,
A love that no one else can claim.
Nothing can compare to this,
To The One who has always been.
(Pre-Chorus)
YahuShua, what can compare to You?
YahuShua, what can compare to You?
(Chorus)
What can compare to Your holiness?
What can compare to Your awesomeness?
What can compare to Your love?
To every blessing You pour from above?
Oh, YahuShua.
What can compare to You?
(Verse 2)
Guiding me through thick and thin,
A hope in me that has always been.
A hand holding me tight, never letting me go,
A wonderfully great love I'll always know.
(Bridge)
What is greater than this?
What is more wonderful than this?
What is more true than this?
What is more loving and forgiving,
Than this?
(Final Chorus)
What can compare to Your holiness?
What can compare to Your awesomeness?
What can compare to Your love?
To every blessing You pour from above?
Oh, YahuShua.
What can compare to You?
